absolute_kinematics.hinge.too_fast_error: It appears that this _Hinge_ is rotating _too fast_.
absolute_kinematics.ponder.ball_joint_in: Assembling Structures using the Ball Joint
Ball Joints attach to the block in front of them
Use Super Glue or Honey Glue to select a group of blocks
When right clicked with an empty hand, it will assemble into a Simulated Contraption
Ball Joints can not directly be moved with Rotational Force
absolute_kinematics.ponder.ball_joint_lo: ...the Ball Joint locks, blocking all rotation
This behavior can be configured using the value panel
absolute_kinematics.ponder.ball_joint_pa: Passing Rotation through a Ball Joint
Rotational power via the Shaft passes directly through the Ball Joint
Rotation remains uninterrupted as the Ball Joint rotates
absolute_kinematics.ponder.hinge_intro.t: Hinges attach to the block in front of them
Use Super Glue or Honey Glue to select a group of blocks
When powered via the shaft, it will assemble into a Simulated Contraption
The Hinge is locked to 90 degrees of rotation on each side, giving a total of 180 degrees of movement
absolute_kinematics.ponder.hinge_passthr: Rotational power via the Shaft passes directly through the Hinge
Rotation remains uninterrupted as the Hinge turns
absolute_kinematics.ponder.hinge_unlocki: This behavior can be configured using the value panel
